capabilities: Create Todoist tasks by tagging checklist items with a sync tag
Sync task edits, subtasks, projects, and labels bidirectionally
Import Todoist tasks into notes via a fuzzy-search command
Embed live Todoist task lists with syncist code blocks and Todoist filter syntax
Type shorthand priorities and due dates that convert to emoji format on sync
disambiguation: Not a general vault sync plugin; it only syncs tasks with the Todoist service.
extras: README states the plugin was built with AI (Claude in Cursor IDE) and manually validated by a human; requires a Todoist API token stored locally and communicates with api.todoist.com.
problem: Tasks added in Obsidian stay disconnected from Todoist, so tasks have to be managed in both apps by hand.

relations.evidence: Tasks Plugin Compatible: Works with the popular Obsidian Tasks plugin emojis (📅, 🔺, ⏫, 🔼, 🔽)
This plugin connects directly to the Todoist API v1 (via Obsidian's built-in requestUrl) to sync tasks.

summary: Bidirectional sync of Obsidian tasks with Todoist, including subtasks, projects, labels, import, and live query blocks.
